text:
Nora (People Ops): Quick thread - Akeem R (Toronto) has two items blocking day-1: work-permit verification and a foreign-degree credential evaluation flagged as 'non-equivalent' by vendor. Day-1 was set for Mon 2025-02-10 09:00 PT. Also Akeem requested captioning and ASL interpreter for orientation.

Akeem R (candidate): Hi all - I have my work permit card (front/back) but vendor wants employer-letter verification instead of the scanned card for remote hires. I can provide the employer letter from my previous contract. I also confirmed I need live captions + ASL for the first week.

Sabrina (Background): Vendor policy: for Canadian work-authorized hires we accept a scanned work permit + employer verification email OR a certified employer letter. If candidate provides employer email address, vendor can reach out and clear faster (explicit candidate consent needed). Degree eval: we can accept a WES report or a notarized translation + copy of diploma.

Akeem R (candidate): I can DM the previous employer contact for verification and upload the WES-application receipt (I haven't received the report yet). Willing to do notarized translation if that helps.

Nora (People Ops): Consent noted. Akeem pls DM the employer contact and upload work_permit_front.pdf, work_permit_back.pdf, and wes_receipt.pdf by EOD tomorrow.

Dalia (People Ops - Accessibility): Thanks for flagging Akeem. We will provide live captions for orientation and arrange ASL interpreter for the first three days. Need a quick intake form: preferred interpreter dialect, any platform preferences, and whether you want interpreter in breakout rooms. Akeem, can you fill the accessibility intake by EOD?

Akeem R (candidate): Filled intake form just now. Prefers on-screen interpreter in breakout rooms. Thanks team.

Tom - IT: Hardware note - laptop held under ticket CAN-2211. Intl power adapter included. For accessibility, we'll enable live captions in Zoom and preload ASL interpreter as a pinned participant. If Akeem needs a specific assistive tech, DM me.

Marta (Benefits): Benefits note for Canadian hires: provincial healthcare enrollment handled after official start. Contractors vs FT differences apply; if Akeem converts we'll adjust benefit effective date. Stipend window is 14 days from confirmed start. If start moves >5 days manager approval needed.

OnboardBot: Reminder: Offer accepted 2025-01-28. If start date changes, update Greenhouse by running `/req update-start`.

Sabrina (Background): If Akeem can provide employer contact consent, vendor outreach usually clears work-permit verification within 48h. WES report will take longer; receipt plus notarized diploma + translation usually suffices for provisional clearance.

Nora (People Ops): Proposed plan:
```
- Akeem DM employer contact for verification (consent given)
- Upload work_permit_front/back + wes_receipt or notarized diploma + translation by 2025-02-03 EOD
- Vendor re-run and provisional clearance within 48-72h after receipts
- Accessibility: captions + ASL arranged for 2025-02-10 orientation (confirmed)
- Tentative orientation: 2025-02-10 09:00 PT (will confirm after vendor returns provisional clearance)
```

Akeem R (candidate): Uploaded work_permit scans and DM'ed previous employer contact (consent included). Also uploaded notarized_translation.pdf in case WES delays.

Sabrina (Background): Received files. Running re-check now. Expect provisional clearance by 2025-02-05 morning PT.

Nora (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Dalia I'll coordinate interpreter assignment and send calendar invite with pinned interpreter. Tom will push laptop ship once clearance confirmed. Marta please hold benefits activation until start confirmed.

Dalia (People Ops - Accessibility): On it. I'll share interpreter details and captions settings in the invite.

Tom - IT: Noted. Will wait on confirmed start before shipping.

Marta (Benefits): Holding on activation. Please ping when start locked.

OnboardBot: Updated candidate timeline: provisional clearance pending. Next auto-reminder in 24h.

Nora (People Ops): TL;DR - candidate provided consent + docs; provisional plan keeps orientation 2025-02-10 with captions/ASL; confirm final start once vendor clears. Everyone react :white_check_mark: when you've actioned your item.

Akeem R (candidate): Thank you all 60a. Appreciate the support and accommodations.
